dogecoin.text: #Dogecoin found out that the maker of ships that go to the #Moon doesn't like it that much.😝

Every #dogecoin millionaire should save some old-fashioned fiat ( that means dollars, for you newbies!). Then they could buy a ticket to Venice to visit the Palace of Doges. Those older Doges really knew how to live back in the day! Woof!
